features: Outdoor mini dome with weather shield (Nocap variant without shield)
IP66/IP67 and NEMA 4X rated, IK08 aluminium/plastic casing
Includes 3 m network cable with RJ-45 connector
Digital PTZ, preset positions, guard tour
Video motion detection and active tampering alarm
release_notes: Specs per official Axis user manual (AXIS M31-VE Series) (um_M3113_3114_40826__en_1104.pdf). Archived copy via the Wayback Machine (original www.axis.com/files/manuals URL). Shared M31-VE series manual; M3114-VE column used. Light sensitivity 1-100 000 lux at F2.0 (colour-only, no day/night) recorded as colour minimum. Manual lists dimensions only as 109 x 51 mm (omitted). ONVIF not stated in this manual.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path; not yet verified on this model.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.
